description: Ranks every covered country on one indicator (« which country has the highest inflation », « where does France stand on debt ») for the latest period most countries share (one harmonised source). Neutral order: highest value first, not best or worst. Not every indicator is rankable (indexes, counts, amounts in local currency are not).

language.description: Language of names and period labels (default en).

name: get_ranking
title: Cross-country ranking
